scope: Only the remaining real PENDING UI sample, real clipboard success/denied-feedback, and Follow actual scroll-coordinate sample. Existing normal-connection/offline recovery evidence is reused only for already covered dimensions; no attempt count inference.

root_approved_scope.script_behavior: synthetic nonsecret stdout/stderr marker waves separated by bounded sleeps, then known nonzero exit 23; actual source text is never printed or persisted
root_approved_scope.task_create_mechanism: filtered safe API helper from the exclusive loopback browser context; real Task Run remains a user-equivalent UI flow
root_approved_scope.api_login: direct login only in browser-page memory; write unique token to current loopback localStorage; verify /api/me after reload; no token leaves eval

tunnel.reason: ClearAllForwardings=yes would remove the command-line -L; `ssh -G kvm2` showed no configured local/remote forward, remote command, agent forwarding or control path.

oracles.pending: timestamped API status and DOM status within bounded polling after real UI Run click; if missed remain PARTIAL
oracles.terminal: GET execution status/exit code and same-page UI status, no reload/navigation
oracles.follow: actual log-container scrollTop/clientHeight/scrollHeight sampled with Follow off/on across incoming real marker waves
oracles.clipboard_success: real Copy button then navigator.clipboard.readText in page; in memory exact compare, persist only length/SHA256/equality boolean
oracles.clipboard_denied: context+origin-specific browser permission deny verified by page Permissions API, then real Copy button; record actual toast/manual-copy/error feedback, do not assert fixed wording or mock
oracles.permission_scope: actual target browserContextId + exact loopback origin; reset only that context before close

cleanup.task: delete only response-ledgered owned Task ID; verify GET 404
cleanup.browser: logout only the exclusive session token; verify old /api/me 401; clear network log; close context
cleanup.tunnel: stop only child matching recorded PID/start ticks/argv; verify listener gone
cleanup.baseline: verify repair/native3 and all baseline Node state unchanged
